data_description.endpoint: The endpoint of the actualbudget server
data_description.password: The password of the actualbudget server
data_description.encrypt_password: The password to encrypt the actualbudget file
data_description.file: The file id of the actualbudget server
data_description.cert: The optional certificate of the actualbudget server
data_description.unit: The currency of the actualbudget server

error.failed_file: Failed to connect: invalid file id

bank_sync.name: Synchronize transactions
bank_sync.description: Downloads latest transactions from all linked bank accounts and inserts them into Actual Budget.

config_entry_id.name: Actual Budget instance
config_entry_id.description: Select the Actual Budget instance to perform the bank sync on.

budget_sync.name: Synchronize budgets
budget_sync.description: Downloads latest budget file from the server and update sensor entities.

config_entry_id.name: Actual Budget instance
config_entry_id.description: Select the Actual Budget instance to perform the budget sync on.

add_transaction.name: Add transaction
add_transaction.description: Creates (or updates, if imported_id matches an existing transaction) a transaction in Actual Budget. Useful for recording bills/invoices from other integrations precisely, without waiting on a generic bank sync.

config_entry_id.name: Actual Budget instance
config_entry_id.description: Select the Actual Budget instance to add the transaction to.

account.name: Account
account.description: Name of the Actual Budget account to add the transaction to.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Positive for a deposit, negative for a payment/expense.

payee.name: Payee
payee.description: Payee name. Created automatically if it doesn't exist yet.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Optional free-text note on the transaction.

category.name: Category
category.description: Optional budget category. Created automatically if it doesn't exist yet.

imported_id.name: Imported ID
imported_id.description: Optional stable unique id (e.g. an invoice number). Calling this action again with the same imported_id updates that transaction instead of creating a duplicate.

clear_account.name: Clear account
clear_account.description: Permanently deletes every transaction on an account. Irreversible short of restoring a budget-file backup - requires confirm to be set to true.

config_entry_id.name: Actual Budget instance
config_entry_id.description: Select the Actual Budget instance to clear the account on.

account.name: Account
account.description: Name of the Actual Budget account to delete all transactions from.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be set to true. A safeguard against accidentally wiping an account's transactions.

import_transactions.name: Import transactions
import_transactions.description: Bulk variant of Add transaction: creates/reconciles many transactions in a single commit. Useful for backfilling a bank statement export.

config_entry_id.name: Actual Budget instance
config_entry_id.description: Select the Actual Budget instance to import the transactions into.

transactions.name: Transactions
transactions.description: List of transaction objects, each with the same fields as Add transaction (account, date, amount, payee, notes, category, imported_id, cleared).

set_budget.name: Set budget
set_budget.description: Sets (creates or overwrites) the envelope-budget amount for a category, for one or more months.

config_entry_id.name: Actual Budget instance
config_entry_id.description: Select the Actual Budget instance to set the budget on.

category.name: Category
category.description: Name of the budget category to set.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Monthly budgeted amount for this category.

months.name: Months
months.description: List of months to set this amount for, as YYYY-MM strings (e.g. ["2026-08", "2026-09"]).
